counter_evidence_and_limits: The repeat-protection behavior existed before MF-C1 and was preserved, not newly implemented. The semantic correction is the private/latest-host-history consistency check plus verification and precise text.

Doctor may die on the same night their protection took effect; privateprevious correctly retains that target until the next resolved night, when no livingDoctor yields null. Do not eagerly clear it at death.
PostGame deliberately clears privateprevious; comparing it with non-null retained hosthistory there would reject valid completedgames. Separate terminal validation remains enforced.
Peer validator cannot compare hostonlyhistory and must never receive it. The complete history-binding invariant is a canonical local-recovery check; peers validate public/own shape.
